trap.label: less … than
trap.wrong: The problem is less technical as social.
trap.right: The problem is less technical than social.
trap.why: Em português “menos técnico quanto social” mistura formas. Em inglês, less usa than.

mcq.q: “Not because it is perfect ___ because they helped.”

fix.wrong: We weeded off the weak items.
fix.right: We weeded out the weak items.

fix.wrong: It was more social as technical.
fix.right: It was more social than technical.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com weed out: “We removed the weak items.” (weeded)
rewrite.answer: We weeded out the weak items.

rewrite.prompt: Substitua por pronome: “We weeded out the errors.”
Reescreva com less…than: “It is more cultural than legal.”
rewrite.answer: It is less legal than cultural.
